75900.meaning1: should be defined; should be distinguished; should be specified
75900.meaningLit: to cause to be controlled down

examples.text: vād'ānuvādo'ti bhagavatā vuttavādassa anuvādo. vād'ānupāto'ti'pi pāṭho, satthu vādassa anupāto anupatanaṃ, anugamanan'ti attho. iminā'pi vādaṃ anugato vādo'y'eva dīpito hoti.

75903.commentary: (THa) saṅkalitaṃ bahūhi vassehī'ti bahukehi saṃvaccharehi sampiṇḍanavasena hadaye ṭhapitaṃ. saṅkhalitan'ti'pi pāṭho, saṅkhalitaṃ viya kataṃ ek'ābaddhavasena vāc'uggataṃ kataṃ. yaṃ buddhavacanan'ti vacanaseso.

examples.text: ukkhepakatavacchassa, saṅkalitaṃ bahūhi vassehi, taṃ bhāsati gahaṭṭhānaṃ, sunisinno uḷārapāmojjo'ti.

75904.meaning1: well seated; sitting properly; (comm) sitting still
75904.commentary: (THa) sunisinno'ti tasmiṃ dhamme sammā niccalo nisinno, lābhasakkār'ādiṃ apaccāsīsanto kevalaṃ vimuttāyatanasīsey'eva ṭhatvā kathetī'ti attho.

examples.text: ukkhepakatavacchassa, saṅkalitaṃ bahūhi vassehi, taṃ bhāsati gahaṭṭhānaṃ, sunisinno uḷārapāmojjo'ti.
sutvāna dhammaṃ mahato mahārasaṃ, sabbaññutaññāṇavarena desitaṃ, maggaṃ papajjiṃ amatassa pattiyā, so yogakkhemassa pathassa kovido'ti.

75906.meaning1: who has infinite knowledge and excellent understanding
75906.commentary: (THa) sabbaññutaññāṇavarena desitan'ti sabbaṃ jānātī'ti sabbaññū, tassa bhāvo sabbaññutā. ñāṇam'eva varaṃ, ñāṇesu vā varan'ti ñāṇavaraṃ, sabbaññutā ñāṇavaraṃ etassā'ti sabbaññutaññāṇavaro, bhagavā. tena sabbaññutaññāṇa-saṅkhāta-aggañāṇena vā karaṇabhūtena desitaṃ kathitaṃ dhammaṃ sutvānā'ti yojanā. yaṃ pan'ettha vattabbaṃ, taṃ param'atthadīpaniyaṃ itivuttakavaṇṇanāyaṃ vuttanayena veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: sutvāna dhammaṃ mahato mahārasaṃ, sabbaññutaññāṇavarena desitaṃ, maggaṃ papajjiṃ amatassa pattiyā, so yogakkhemassa pathassa kovido'ti.

75907.meaning1: practiced; followed a course of action; followed a method

examples.text: sutvāna dhammaṃ mahato mahārasaṃ, sabbaññutaññāṇavarena desitaṃ, maggaṃ papajjiṃ amatassa pattiyā, so yogakkhemassa pathassa kovido'ti.

75909.meaning1: seeing the extremely refined and subtle truth; who perceives the exquisite and subtle goal
75909.commentary: (THa) susukhuma-nipuṇ'atthadassinā'ti ativiya duddas'aṭṭhena sukhume, saṇh'aṭṭhena nipuṇe saccapaṭiccasamuppād'ādiatthe aniccat'ādiṃ oropetvā passatī'ti susukhumanipuṇ'atthadassī, tena.

examples.text: susukhuma-nipuṇ'atthadassinā, matikusalena nivātavuttinā, saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā, nibbānaṃ na hi tena dullabhan'ti.

75910.meaning1: extremely fine; very subtle; very refined
75910.commentary: (THa) susukhuma-nipuṇ'atthadassinā'ti ativiya duddas'aṭṭhena sukhume, saṇh'aṭṭhena nipuṇe saccapaṭiccasamuppād'ādiatthe aniccat'ādiṃ oropetvā passatī'ti susukhumanipuṇ'atthadassī, tena.

examples.text: susukhuma-nipuṇ'atthadassinā, matikusalena nivātavuttinā, saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā, nibbānaṃ na hi tena dullabhan'ti.

75911.meaning1: skilled in thought; adept in mind
75911.commentary: (THa) matikusalenā'ti matiyā paññāya kusalena chekena, evaṃ pavattamānassa paññā vaḍḍhati, evaṃ na vaḍḍhatī'ti dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅga-paññāya uppādane kusalena.

examples.text: susukhumanipuṇ'atthadassinā, matikusalena nivātavuttinā, saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā, nibbānaṃ na hi tena dullabhan'ti.

75912.meaning1: who has practiced and is developed in ethics; (or) who has attended on one who is developed in virtue
75912.commentary: (THa) saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā'ti saṃsevitaṃ āciṇṇaṃ vuddhasīlaṃ saṃsevitavuddhasīlaṃ, taṃ yassa atthi, tena saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā. atha vā saṃsevitā upāsitā vuddhasīlino etenā'ti saṃsevitavuddhasīlī, tena.

examples.text: susukhumanipuṇ'atthadassinā, matikusalena nivātavuttinā, saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā, nibbānaṃ na hi tena dullabhan'ti.

75913.commentary: (THa) saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā'ti saṃsevitaṃ āciṇṇaṃ vuddhasīlaṃ saṃsevitavuddhasīlaṃ, taṃ yassa atthi, tena saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā.

examples.text: susukhumanipuṇ'atthadassinā, matikusalena nivātavuttinā, saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā, nibbānaṃ na hi tena dullabhan'ti.
yathā kaḷīro susu vaḍḍhit'aggo, dunnikkhamo hoti pasākhajāto, evaṃ ahaṃ bhariyāy'ānitāya, anumaññaṃ maṃ pabbajito'mhi dānī'ti.
yathā kaḷīro susu vaḍḍhit'aggo, dunnikkhamo hoti pasākhajāto, evaṃ ahaṃ bhariyāy'ānitāya, anumaññaṃ maṃ pabbajito'mhi dānī'ti.

75916.commentary: (THa) evaṃ ahaṃ bhariyāy'ānītāyā'ti yathā vaṃso vaḍḍhit'aggo vaṃs'antaresu saṃsaṭṭha sākhāpasākho veḷugumbato dunnīharaṇīyo hoti, evaṃ aham'pi bhariyāya mayhaṃ ānītāya puttadhīt'ādi-vasena vaḍḍhit'aggo āsattivasena ghar'āvāsato dunnīharaṇīyo bhaveyyaṃ.

examples.text: yathā kaḷīro susu vaḍḍhit'aggo, dunnikkhamo hoti pasākhajāto, evaṃ ahaṃ bhariyāy'ānitāya, anumaññaṃ maṃ pabbajito'mhi dānī'ti.

75917.meaning1: (of an arranged wife) not brought home; not fetched

75918.meaning1: easily removable; easy to take out

75919.meaning1: removable; able to be taken out

75920.meaning1: not easily removable; difficult to take out

75921.meaning1: having gone forth (from); having left the household life
75921.commentary: (THa) nikkhamitūnā'ti nikkhamitvā, ayam'eva vā pāṭho. pabbajj'ādhippāyena gharato niggantvā.

examples.text: jiṇṇañ'ca disvā dukhitañ'ca byādhitaṃ, matañ'ca disvā gatam'āyusaṅkhayaṃ, tato ahaṃ nikkhamitūna pabbajiṃ, pahāya kāmāni manoramānī'ti.

75922.meaning1: who has practiced well; who is properly composed; epithet of an arahant
75922.commentary: (THa) suvihitāna dassanan'ti suvihitānaṃ dassanaṃ. gāthāsukh'atthaṃ anusvāralopo kato. sīl'ādiguṇehi susaṃvihitattabhāvānaṃ par'ānuddayāya suṭṭhu vihitadhammadesanānaṃ ariyānaṃ dassanaṃ sādhū'ti yojanā. dassanan'ti nidassanamattaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ savan'ādīnam'pi bahukārattā.

examples.text: sādhu suvihitāna dassanaṃ, kaṅkhā chijjati buddhi vaḍḍhati, bālam'pi karonti paṇḍitaṃ, tasmā sādhu sataṃ samāgamo'ti.

75923.commentary: (THa) dukkhajātassā'ti jātiādi-vasena uppannadukkhassa, tissannaṃ vā dukkhatānaṃ vasena dukkhasabhāvassa.

examples.text: anekajātisaṃsāraṃ, sandhāvissaṃ anibbisaṃ, tassa me dukkhajātassa, dukkhakkhandho aparaddho'ti.

75925.commentary: (THa) supitvānā'ti niddāyitvā, rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhetī'ti-ādinā vuttaṃ jāgariyaṃ ananuyuñjitvā kevalaṃ rattiyā tīsu'pi yāmesu niddaṃ okkamitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: sabbarattiṃ supitvāna, divā saṅgaṇike rato, kudāssu nāma dummedho, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatī'ti.

75926.meaning1: qualities of the mind; object of meditation
75926.commentary: (THa) cittanimittassa kovido'ti bhāvanācittassa nimittaggahaṇe kusalo, imasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggahetabbaṃ, imasmiṃ sampahaṃsitabbaṃ, imasmiṃ ajjhupekkhitabban'ti evaṃ paggahaṇ'ādiyogyassa cittanimittassa gahaṇe cheko.

examples.text: cittanimittassa kovido, pavivekarasaṃ vijāniya, jhāyaṃ nipako patissato, adhigaccheyya sukhaṃ nirāmisan'ti.

75927.meaning1: adherent of another religion; who professes another doctrine

examples.text: ito bahiddhā puthu aññavādinaṃ, maggo na nibbānagamo yathā ayaṃ, itissu saṅghaṃ bhagav'ānusāsati, satthā sayaṃ pāṇitale'va dassayanti.

75928.meaning1: to raise (out of, onto); to carry up (from, to); to lift up (from, to)

examples.text: asakkhiṃ vata attānaṃ, uddhātuṃ udakā thalaṃ, vuyhamāno mah'ogh'eva, saccāni paṭivijjhahan'ti.

75929.meaning1: mud and mire; mire and marshes
75929.commentary: (THa) paṅkapalipā'ti paṅkā ca palipā ca. paṅko vuccati pakatikaddamo. palipo'ti gambhīraputhulo mahākaddamo. idha pana paṅko viyā'ti paṅko, kāmarāgo asucibhāv'āpādanena cittassa makkhanato.

examples.text: uttiṇṇā paṅkapalipā, pātālā parivajjitā, mutto oghā ca ganthā ca, sabbe mānā visaṃhatā'ti.

75931.meaning1: with one hundred flavours; (or) consisting of one hundred dishes
75931.commentary: (THa) satarasan'ti satarasabhojanaṃ satarasabhojanaṃ nāma satapākasappiādīhi abhisaṅkhataṃ bhojanan'ti vadanti. atha vā anek'attho satasaddo sataso sahassaso'ti-ādīsu viya. tasmā yaṃ bhojanaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, taṃ anekarasatāya satarasan'ti vuccati, nānārasabhojanan'ti attho.

examples.text: na tathā mataṃ satarasaṃ, sudh'annaṃ yaṃ may'ajja paribhuttaṃ, aparimitadassinā gotamena, buddhena desito dhammo'ti.

75932.commentary: (THa) na tathā mataṃ satarasaṃ, sudh'annaṃ yaṃ may'ajja paribhuttan'ti… sudhā eva annaṃ sudhābhojanaṃ devānaṃ āhāro.

examples.text: na tathā mataṃ satarasaṃ, sudh'annaṃ yaṃ may'ajja paribhuttaṃ, aparimitadassinā gotamena, buddhena desito dhammo'ti.

75933.meaning1: of infinite vision; (or) who sees the immeasurable
75933.commentary: (THa) tass'attho, aparimitaṃ aparicchinnaṃ uppādavay'ābhāvato santaṃ asaṅkhatadhātuṃ sayambhūñāṇena passī, aparimitassa anant'āparimeyyassa ñeyyassa dassāvī'ti tena aparimitadassinā

examples.text: na tathā mataṃ satarasaṃ, sudh'annaṃ yaṃ may'ajja paribhuttaṃ, aparimitadassinā gotamena, buddhena desito dhammo'ti.

75934.meaning1: with destroyed eyes; with ruined vision
75934.commentary: (THa) hatanetto'ti vinaṭṭhacakkhuko, tena payogavipattivasen'āhaṃ upahatanettatāya andho, na jacc'andhabhāvenā'ti yathāvuttaṃ andhabhāvaṃ viseseti.

examples.text: andho'haṃ hatanetto'smi, kantār'addhānapakkhando, sayamāno'pi gacchissaṃ, na sahāyena pāpenā'ti.

75935.meaning1: set out on a long desert road; entered a road through a wasteland
75935.commentary: (THa) kantār'addhānapakkhando'ti kantāre vivane dīghamaggaṃ anupaviṭṭho, na jātikantār'ādigahanaṃ saṃsār'addhānaṃ paṭipanno'ti adhippāyo. (NIDD1a) yathā kantār'addhānapakkhandā'ti yasmā balavanto purisā hatthabhāraṃ gahetvā sajj'āvudhā saparivārā kantāraṃ paṭipajjanti, te corā dūrato'va disvā palāyanti. te sotthinā kantāraṃ nittharitvā khem'antaṃ patvā haṭṭhatuṭṭhā honti. tasmā kantārapakkhandā khem'antabhūmiṃ patthenti.

examples.text: andho'haṃ hatanetto'smi, kantār'addhānapakkhando, sayamāno'pi gacchissaṃ, na sahāyena pāpenā'ti.

75937.commentary: (THa) ekapupphan'ti ekaṃ kusumaṃ, taṃ pana idha sumanapupphaṃ adhippetaṃ.

examples.text: ekapupphaṃ cajitvāna, asīti vassakoṭiyo, saggesu paricāretvā, sesaken'amhi nibbuto'ti.
apare pana asitāsu mayā'ti lavittehi karaṇabhūtehi mayā khujjitan'ti vadanti. tesaṃ matena karaṇ'atthe hetumhi vā bhummavacanaṃ.

75940.construction: pati > paty > pacc + upa + ṭhā + ti

examples.text: tañ'h'idaṃ sīlaṃ kāyasoceyyaṃ vacīsoceyyaṃ manosoceyyan'ti evaṃ vuttasoceyyapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ, soceyyabhāvena paccupaṭṭhāti gahaṇabhāvaṃ gacchati. hirottappañ'ca pana tassa viññūhi padaṭṭhānan'ti vaṇṇitaṃ, āsannakāraṇan'ti attho.

75941.commentary: (THa) asīti vassakoṭiyo'ti manussagaṇanāya vassānaṃ asīti koṭiyo, accantasaṃyoge c'etaṃ upayogavacanaṃ, idañ'ca chasu kāmasaggesu dutiye apar'āpar'uppattivasena vuttan'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: ekapupphaṃ cajitvāna, asīti vassakoṭiyo, saggesu paricāretvā, sesaken'amhi nibbuto'ti.

75942.commentary: (THa) satapalan'ti sataṃ palāni yassa, taṃ satapalaparimāṇaṃ. (JAa) satapalan'ti palasatena suvaṇṇena kāritaṃ.

examples.text: hitvā satapalaṃ kaṃsaṃ, sovaṇṇaṃ satarājikaṃ, aggahiṃ mattikāpattaṃ, idaṃ dutiy'ābhisecanan'ti.

75943.commentary: (THa) ten'āha idaṃ dutiy'ābhisecanan'ti. paṭhamaṃ rajj'ābhisecanaṃ upādāya idaṃ pabbajj'ūpagamanaṃ mama dutiyaṃ abhisecanaṃ. (JAa) taṃ dutiy'ābhisecanan'ti bhikkhave, taṃ mattikāpattaggahaṇaṃ dutiy'ābhisecanaṃ katvā so rājā nikkhanto'ti.

examples.text: hitvā satapalaṃ kaṃsaṃ, sovaṇṇaṃ satarājikaṃ, aggahiṃ mattikāpattaṃ, idaṃ dutiy'ābhisecanan'ti.

75944.meaning1: leading to the root of rebecoming; conducive to the cause of existence
75944.commentary: (THa) tassa vaḍḍhanti āsavā bhavamūl'opagāmino'ti bhavassa saṃsārassa mūlabhāvaṃ kāraṇabhāvaṃ upagamanasabhāvā kām'āsav'ādayo cattāro'pi āsavā tassa puggalassa upar'ūpari vaḍḍhanti'y'eva, na hāyanti.

examples.text: rūpaṃ disvā sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto, sārattacitto vedeti, tañ'ca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati, tassa vaḍḍhanti āsavā, bhavamūl'opagāmino'ti.

75945.meaning1: leading to becoming; conducive to being

examples.text: rūpaṃ disvā sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto, sārattacitto vedeti, tañ'ca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati, tassa vaḍḍhanti āsavā, bhavamūlā bhavagāmino'ti.

75946.meaning1: accomplished in the correct application of effort
75946.commentary: (THa) sammappadhānasampanno'ti sampanna-catubbidha-sammappadhāno, tehi kattabbakiccaṃ sampādetvā ṭhito'ti attho.

examples.text: sammappadhānasampanno, satipaṭṭhānagocaro, vimuttikusumasañchanno, parinibbissaty'anāsavo'ti.

75947.meaning1: with attending mindfully as pasture; with mindfulness as one's domain
75947.commentary: (THa) satipaṭṭhānagocaro'ti kāyānupassan'ādayo satipaṭṭhānā gocaro pavattiṭṭhānaṃ etassā'ti satipaṭṭhānagocaro, catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu patiṭṭhitacitto'ti attho.

examples.text: sammappadhānasampanno, satipaṭṭhānagocaro, vimuttikusumasañchanno, parinibbissaty'anāsavo'ti.

75948.meaning1: festooned with the flowers of final freedom; adorned with the blossoms of deliverance
75948.commentary: (THa) guṇasobhena paramasugandhā vimutti'y'eva kusumāni, tehi sabbaso samma'd'eva sañchanno vibhūsito alaṅ'kato'ti vimuttikusumasañchanno

examples.text: sammappadhānasampanno, satipaṭṭhānagocaro, vimuttikusumasañchanno, parinibbissaty'anāsavo'ti.

75950.construction:
√gah > geh > gih + a + ī + tta
gihī + tta

examples.text: hitvā gihittaṃ anavositatto, mukhanaṅgalī odariko kusīto, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando'ti.

75951.meaning1: digging oneself into trouble with one's mouth
75951.commentary: (THa) mukhasaṅkhātaṃ naṅgalaṃ imassa atthī'ti mukhanaṅgalī. naṅgalena viya pathaviṃ paresu pharusavācappayogena attānaṃ khananto'ti attho.

examples.text: hitvā gihittaṃ anavositatto, mukhanaṅgalī odariko kusīto, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando'ti.

75952.meaning1: being dirtied (by); being soiled (by); becoming impure (through)
75952.commentary: (THa) saṅkhāresu saṃkilissamānāse'ti ajjhattikabāhiresu cakkh'ādīsu c'eva rūp'ādīsu ca saṅkhatadhammesu saṃkilissamānā, etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti taṃnimittaṃ taṇhāgāh'ādi-vasena saṃkilesaṃ āpajjamānā.

examples.text: mānena vañcitāse, saṅkhāresu saṃkilissamānāse, lābh'ālābhena mathitā, samādhiṃ n'ādhigacchantī'ti.
n'āhaṃ etena atthiko, sukhito dhammarasena tappito, pītvāna ras'aggam'uttamaṃ, na ca kāhāmi visena santhavan'ti.

75954.meaning1: with one hundred characteristics; with a hundred features
75954.commentary: (THa) sataliṅgassā'ti līnam'atthaṃ gamentī'ti liṅgāni, atthesu saddassa pavattinimittāni, tāni pana sataṃ anekāni liṅgāni etassā'ti sataliṅgo. anek'attho hi idha satasaddo, sataṃ sahassan'ti-ādīsu viya na saṅkhyāvises'attho tassa sataliṅgassa.

examples.text: sataliṅgassa atthassa, satalakkhaṇadhārino, ek'aṅgadassī dummedho, satadassī ca paṇḍito'ti.

75955.meaning1: with one hundred amazing qualities; carrying a hundred auspicious characteristics
75955.commentary: (THa) satalakkhaṇadhārino'ti anekalakkhaṇavato. lakkhīyati etenā'ti lakkhaṇaṃ, paccayabhāvino atthassa attano phalaṃ paṭicca paccayabhāvo, tena hi so ayaṃ imassa kāraṇan'ti lakkhīyati. so ca ekass'eva atthassa anekappabhedo upalabbhati, ten'āha satalakkhaṇadhārino'ti. atha vā lakkhīyantī'ti lakkhaṇāni, tassa tassa atthassa saṅkhatat'ādayo pakāravisesā te pana atthato avatthāvisesā veditabbā.

examples.text: sataliṅgassa atthassa, satalakkhaṇadhārino, ek'aṅgadassī dummedho, satadassī ca paṇḍito'ti.

75956.meaning1: seeing one hundred (aspects); understanding a hundred (angles)
75956.commentary: (THa) satadassī ca paṇḍito'ti paṇḍito pana tattha vijjamāne aneke'pi pakāre attano paññācakkhunā sabbaso passati. yo vā tattha labbhamāne aneke paññācakkhunā attanā'pi passati, aññesam'pi dasseti pakāseti, so paṇḍito vicakkhaṇo atthesu kusalo nāmā'ti.

examples.text: sataliṅgassa atthassa, satalakkhaṇadhārino, ek'aṅgadassī dummedho, satadassī ca paṇḍito'ti.

75957.commentary: (THa) pabbajiṃ tulayitvānā'ti sambādho ghar'āvāso raj'āpatho'ti-ādinā (dī. ni. 1.191, ma. ni. 2.10, saṃ. ni. 2.154) ghar'āvāse, app'assādā kāmā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā'ti-ādinā (pāci. 417, ma. ni. 1.177) kāmesu ādīnavaṃ tappaṭipakkhato nekkhamme ca ānisaṃsaṃ tulabhūtāya paññāya vicāretvā vīmaṃsitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: pabbajiṃ tulayitvāna, agārasm'ānagāriyaṃ, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.

75958.meaning1: having compassion for one's ultimate welfare; concerned for one's highest good
75958.commentary: (THa) paramahit'ānukampino'ti paramaṃ ativiya, paramena vā anuttarena hitena satte anukampanasīlassa bhagavato.

examples.text: na nūn'āyaṃ paramahit'ānukampino, rahogato anuvigaṇeti sāsanaṃ, tathā'h'ayaṃ viharati pākat'indriyo, migī yathā taruṇajātikā vane'ti.

75959.meaning1: tender; young; immature; inexperienced; (or) with a young child
75959.commentary: (THa) yassa taṇhāsaṅgassa acchinnatāya so bhikkhu pākat'indriyo viharati, tassa upamaṃ dassento migī yathā taruṇajātikā vane'ti āha. yathā ayaṃ taruṇasabhāvā migī puttasnehassa acchinnatāya vane dukkhaṃ anubhavati, na taṃ ativattati, evam'ayam'pi bhikkhu saṅgassa acchinnatāya pākat'indriyo viharanto vaṭṭadukkhaṃ n'ātivattatī'ti adhippāyo. taruṇavijātikā'ti vā pāṭho. abhinavappasutā bālavacchā'ti attho.

examples.text: na nūn'āyaṃ paramahit'ānukampino, rahogato anuvigaṇeti sāsanaṃ, tathā'h'ayaṃ viharati pākat'indriyo, migī yathā taruṇajātikā vane'ti.

75965.meaning1: with the forest in mind; intent on the wilderness
75965.commentary: (THa) vivekakāmassā'ti kilesavivittaṃ cittavivekaṃ icchantassa, araññavāsena tāva kāyaviveko laddho, idāni upadhivivek'ādhigamassa nissayabhūto cittaviveko laddhabbo'ti taṃ patthayamānassa, jāgariyaṃ anuyuñjantassā'ti attho, ten'āha araññasaññino'ti. araññavāso nāma satthārā vaṇṇito thomito. so ca kho yāva'd'eva samatha-vipassanā-bhāvanāpāripūriyā, tasmā sā mayā hatthagatā kātabbā'ti evaṃ araññagatasaññino nekkhammasaṅkappabahulassā'ti attho.

examples.text: nagā nag'aggesu susaṃvirūḷhā, udaggameghena navena sittā, vivekakāmassa araññasaññino, janeti bhiyyo usabhassa kalyatan'ti.

75967.commentary: (THa) mahājhāyī'ti mahantehi jhānehi jhāyanasīlā, mahantaṃ vā nibbānaṃ jhāyantī'ti mahājhāyī.

examples.text: tevijjo'haṃ mahājhāyī, cetosamathakovido, sadattho me anuppatto, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.

75968.meaning1: skilled in stilling the mind; expert in peace of heart
75968.commentary: (THa) cetosamathakovido'ti cittasaṅkhobhakarānaṃ saṃkilesadhammānaṃ vūpasamanena cetaso samādahane kusalo.

examples.text: acchodikā puthusilā, gonaṅgulamig'āyutā, ambusevālasañchannā, te selā ramayanti man'ti.

75971.meaning1: weighed down with sluggishness; heavy with physical inertia; (comm) esteeming physical fitness; (or) prioritising meditation on ugliness
75971.commentary: (THa) kāyaduṭṭhullagaruno'ti duṭṭhullaṃ asubhayogyatā, kāyassa duṭṭhullaṃ kāyaduṭṭhullaṃ, kāyaduṭṭhullaṃ garu sambhāvitaṃ yassa so kāyaduṭṭhullagaru, anissaraṇappañño hutvā kāyaposanappasuto kāyadaḷhibahulo'ti attho, tassa kāyaduṭṭhullagaruno.

examples.text: kāyaduṭṭhullagaruno, hiyyamānamhi jīvite, sarīrasukhagiddhassa, kuto samaṇasādhutā'ti.

75972.meaning1: greedy for physical pleasure; desiring physical comfort
75972.commentary: (THa) sarīrasukhagiddhassā'ti paṇīt'āhār'ādīhi attano kāyassa sukhena gedhaṃ āpannassa.

examples.text: kāyaduṭṭhullagaruno, hiyyamānamhi jīvite, sarīrasukhagiddhassa, kuto samaṇasādhutā'ti.

75974.commentary: (THa) kuto samaṇasādhutā'ti evarūpassa puggalassa samaṇabhāvena sādhutā susamaṇatā kuto kena kāraṇena siyā, ek'aṃsato pana kāye jīvite ca nirapekkhassa itar'ītarasantosena santuṭṭhassa āraddhavīriyass'eva samaṇasādhutā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: kāyaduṭṭhullagaruno, hiyyamānamhi jīvite, sarīrasukhagiddhassa, kuto samaṇasādhutā'ti.

examples.text: kāyaduṭṭhullagaruno, hiyyamānamhi jīvite, sarīrasukhagiddhassa, kuto samaṇasādhutā'ti.

75989.meaning1: what is called a 'net'; what is known as the 'web'
75989.commentary: (THa) pahīno jālasaṅkhāto'ti sattasantānassa ottharaṇato nissarituṃ appadānato ca jālasaṅkhāto'ti ca laddhanāmā diṭṭhi avijjā ca pahīnā maggena samucchinnā.

suddhe anūne mama bhikkhusaṅghe, lokā ito nissarituṃ khamante, pabhātakāle byasanaṅ'gatānaṃ, disvāna niyyāti'va candalekhā.

75991.commentary: (THa) so kuhako attānaṃ hananto suhataṃ katvā hanti vināseti, yathā kiṃ? vītaṃsen'eva pakkhimā'ti, vītaṃso'ti dīpakasakuṇo, tena. pakkhimā'ti sākuṇiko. yathā tena vītaṃsasakuṇena aññe sakuṇe vañcetvā hananto attānaṃ idha loke'pi hanati viññugaraha-sāvajjasabhāv'ādinā, samparāyaṃ pana duggatiparikkilesena hanati'y'eva, na pana te sakuṇe pacchā hantuṃ sakkoti, evaṃ kuhako'pi kohaññena lokaṃ vañcetvā idha loke'pi attānaṃ hanati vippaṭisāraviññugarah'ādīhi, paraloke'pi duggatiparikkilesehi, na pana te paccayadāyake apāyadukkhaṃ pāpeti.

examples.text: ye kho te veṭhamissena, nānattena ca kammunā, manusse uparundhanti, pharus'ūpakkamā janā, te'pi tatth'eva kīranti, na hi kammaṃ panassati.

75998.meaning1: need for people; use of men
75998.commentary: (THa) ko hi tassa janen'attho'ti tassa aññajanassa aññena janena taṇhāvasena assitena dosavasena heṭhitena vā ko attho.

examples.text: ko hi tassa janen'attho, janena janitena vā, janaṃ ohāya gacchaṃ taṃ, heṭhayitvā bahuṃ janan'ti.

75999.meaning1: having hurt; having harmed; having harassed
75999.commentary: (THa) janaṃ ohāya gacchaṃ taṃ, heṭhayitvā bahuṃ janan'ti yasmā saṃsāre carato janassa ayam'ev'ānurūpā paṭipatti, tasmā taṃ janaṃ, tassa ca bādhikā yā sā taṇhā ca, yo ca so doso eva bahuṃ janaṃ bādhayitvā ṭhito, tañ'ca ohāya sabbaso pahāya pariccajitvā gacchaṃ, tehi anupaddutaṃ ṭhānaṃ gaccheyyaṃ pāpuṇeyyan'ti attho. (JAa) heṭhayitvā'ti viheṭhetvā visapītakaṇḍena vijjhitvā jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpetvā.

examples.text: ko hi tassa janen'attho, janena janitena vā, janaṃ ohāya gacchaṃ taṃ, heṭhayitvā bahuṃ janan'ti.
